CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

2. Which response best shows understanding of The little? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The little with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The little has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The little.
   D. Use The little to insult classmates of other faiths.
